record.paper_title: Some open problems in mathematical two-dimensional conformal field theory
record.original_question: In the nonsemisimple setting relevant to logarithmic conformal field theories, can one define the correct notion of modular tensor category and prove that the braided tensor category of grading-restricted generalized modules for a simple C2-cofinite vertex operator algebra satisfying V(0)=C1, V(n)=0 for n<0, and V' equivalent to V has this structure? From such a nonsemisimple modular tensor category, can one still construct a three-dimensional topological quantum field theory and invariants of knots and 3-manifolds?

evidence.quote: For a logarithmic conformal field theory, since the category is not semisimple, it is not sufficient to consider only irreducible modules. So giving the correct definition of modular tensor category in the case of logarithmic conformal field theories is also an important unsolved problem.

Problem 5.2. Give a definition of modular tensor category in the nonsemisimple case and prove that the braided tensor category in Conjecture 5.1 has such a modular tensor category structure. From such a nonsemisimple modular tensor category, can we still construct a 3-dimensional topological quantum field theory and invariants of knots and 3-manifolds?

artifact.status_search_result: Substantial progress has been made on all three parts. Definitions of nonsemisimple (finite factorizable ribbon) modular tensor categories have been formulated (Lyubashenko; Kerler–Lyubashenko; Shimizu). Huang and collaborators (notably Creutzig–Jiang–Hung–Yang and McRae) have established that the category of grading-restricted generalized modules for a $C_2$-cofinite VOA satisfying the stated conditions is a finite (often rigid factorizable) braided ribbon tensor category, with modular invariance of pseudo-trace conformal blocks proved (Fiordalisi; recent work of McRae–Yang and others 2023–2024). De Renzi–Gainutdinov–Patureau-Mirand–Runkel–Tarrach (Selecta Math. 2021) constructed 3d TQFTs from nonsemisimple modular categories, producing knot and 3-manifold invariants. Full rigidity of $\mathcal{C}_V$ in complete generality and a uniform TQFT construction directly from VOA data remain not fully settled, so the overall problem is partially solved.

status_evidence.title: 3-Dimensional TQFTs from non-semisimple modular categories
status_evidence.snippet: Construction of 3d TQFTs and knot/3-manifold invariants from nonsemisimple modular categories.
status_evidence.claim: Part (c) has been achieved in significant generality.

status_evidence.title: On rationality for C_2-cofinite vertex operator algebras
status_evidence.snippet: For C₂-cofinite VOAs of CFT type the category of grading-restricted generalized modules is a (possibly nonsemisimple) finite braided ribbon tensor category.
status_evidence.claim: Part (b) is largely established for the stated class of VOAs.

status_evidence.title: Modular Invariance of (Logarithmic) Intertwining Operators
status_evidence.snippet: Modular invariance results for pseudo-q-traces of logarithmic intertwining operators among grading-restricted generalized modules for C₂-cofinite VOAs.
status_evidence.claim: Modular invariance, needed for the modular tensor structure, is proven.

status_evidence.title: Renormalized Hennings Invariants and 2+1-TQFTs
status_evidence.snippet: Nonsemisimple TQFTs and renormalized 3-manifold invariants from unimodular ribbon categories.
status_evidence.claim: Definitions and TQFT constructions in the nonsemisimple setting exist.
